dedupe_keys.name: supplemental data for spatially resolved measurements in tropical reservoirs reveal elevated methane ebullition at river inflows and at high productivity

description: Supplemental Data for "Spatially Resolved Measurements in Tropical Reservoirs Reveal Elevated Methane Ebullition at River Inflows and at High Productivity" is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Uppsala universitet. An increasing number of rivers are being dammed, particularly in the tropics, and reservoir water surfaces can be a substantial anthropogenic source of greenhouse gases. On average, 80% of the CO2-equivalent emission of reservoirs globally has been attributed to CH4, which is predominantly emitted via ebullition. Coverage: Uppsala universitet. The publisher named on the listing is Uppsala universitet. Its keywords include climate, klimat, environmental sciences, ecology, ekologi, miljövetenskaper. The listing shows 2024-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
